# VascularisedBrainOrganoids

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Three-dimensional neural cultures engineered with a vascular network to improve nutrient delivery and mimic in vivo brain microenvironments. Provides a more physiologically relevant substrate for studying neuronal avalanche dynamics and self-organized criticality in complex neural tissue.
